rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: ring boulevard - the palm boulevard round the island (zone 1165 -> about 1000, palms); civic and parks - clumps of 3-5 at the edges, open lawn in the middle
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's nineteen builder trees go (a row of fan palms every 20 m along Ocean Boulevard behind the box hedge, a queen palm and a jacaranda squeezed into the hedge, broadleaf scattered over the lawn); thirteen come back on their own spots: the seven boulevard palms, and two clumps of three at the lawn's east and west edges, the middle left open.
